execution.raw_text:
{
  "up": "Select molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles
Join activities on activities.record_id = compound_records.record_id
Join assays on assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id
Join target_dictionary on target_dictionary.tid = assays.tid
Join compound_structures on compound_structures.molregno = activities.molregno
Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4792'
Filter assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
Filter activities.type = 'IC50'
Filter activities.standard_relation = '='
Filter activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL
Filter activities.standard_units = 'nM'
Join molecule_dictionary on molecule_dictionary.molregno = activities.molregno
Filter molecule_dictionary.molecule_type = 'Small molecule'
Return molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles
Sort by molecule_chembl_id
"
}
